    • compare

      default int compare(String string1, String string2)
      Compares the ASCII representation of 2 strings ignoring case.

      Both parameters will have all non ASCII characters replaced with ASCII characters before comparison.

      Specified by:
      compare in interface Comparator<String>
      Parameters:
      string1 - the first string to be compared
      string2 - the second string to be compared
      Returns:
      the value 0 if string1 is equal to this string2 or if both are null; a value less than 0 if this string1 is lexicographically less than the string2 or string2 is null; and a value greater than 0 if string1 is lexicographically greater than the string2 or string2 is null.

    • contains

      default boolean contains(String string, String substring)
      Returns true if and only if the ASCII representation of a string contains the ASCII representation of another one ignoring case.

      Both parameters will have all non ASCII characters replaced with ASCII characters before execution.

      Parameters:
      string - the string to be parsed
      substring - the substring to search for
      Returns:
      true if the specified string contains the specified substring or both are null, false otherwise
